description: This file defines a class TestlinkXMLRPCServer that extends IXR_Server and provides an XML-RPC interface for interacting with the TestLink test management system. It includes methods for authentication, validating input parameters, retrieving test plan and test case information, as well as recording test results. The class interacts heavily with database objects and manages test execution data, test plans, test cases, and user permissions. It serves as the core API endpoint for external applications to automate testing workflows via XML-RPC.

classes.name: TestlinkXMLRPCServer
classes.description: A class that extends IXR_Server to provide an API for interacting with TestLink via XML-RPC, including test plan management, execution results, user permissions, and test case information.

classes.name: TestlinkXMLRPCServer
classes.description: A class extending IXR_Server that exposes an XML-RPC API for managing tests, test plans, test cases, results, and associated data. It handles authentication, permission verification, data validation, and database interactions to facilitate external automation workflows.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the server, sets up database connection, manages internal managers for test cases, projects, plans, users, and settings, and registers callback methods.

methods.name: _connectToDB
methods.description: Sets up the database connection based on environment (testing or production) and configures character set for MySQL.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Verifies the devKey provided in the request against the database, loads the corresponding user, and starts logging transaction if valid.

methods.name: checkIsSystemWideAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the authenticated user has system administrator privileges.

methods.name: userHasRight
methods.description: Determines whether the user has a specific permission for a test project and plan, considering public/private project attributes and user roles.

methods.name: getLatestBuildForTestPlan

methods.name: getLastExecutionResult

methods.name: getAllExecutionsResults
methods.description: Returns all execution records for a test case within a test plan, with optional filters for build and platform, and inclusion of bugs.

methods.name: sayHello
methods.description: A simple server check method returning 'Hello!'

methods.name: repeat
methods.description: Repeats a message back to the caller.

methods.name: about
methods.description: Provides basic information about the API version and authorship.
